beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A proposed future-impact ledger preserves assumptions about long-term effects for later review.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Comparing those expectations with outcomes helps an institution learn after its staff have changed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book connects these designs with evidence histories, education, and institutions that check one another.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its proposals remain contestable, including the rules imposed by attention-protection systems themselves.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The central shift is from producing more answers to preserving conditions for judgment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with The Attention Constitution for the concrete question of whom an assistant serves.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Follow Institutions for Time to see how that responsibility extends beyond the immediate request.
